adapted_from: the evals.json shape of github.com/coreyhaines31/marketingskills skills/*/evals/evals.json at commit 1efedbc5148b54b2f0f6c6c9fe0be62e151c7fff (MIT; see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)
description: The outreach workflow's example set (US-ME14, F5), in the marketingskills evals.json shape. A deterministic assertion is checked by the unit tests (src/tests/test_example_sets.py) against the synthetic kit, whose channel plan names three synthetic creators, and the Listening set's snapshot, which holds one creator's feed; a judged assertion waits for US-ME16. An example's first file is its candidate Draft; a second file is the Founder's record of what was sent and answered, as Mandu would hold it, with the day the run happens.

assertion_kinds.deterministic: check is one of: offered; blocked_by (rule: a finding's rule, or the start of one); not_offered (reason: part of the reason); carries_source_link; no_hook_found; cites_work (link)
assertion_kinds.judged: text is a statement a reviewer, or a model at US-ME16, judges true or false of the agent's Draft

evals.prompt: Draft the personal-network ask from the brief.
evals.expected_output: An identity-framed ask that carries the personal-network Source link exactly as the Waitlist Dispatch request defines it, once in the message and once in a line a friend can forward; the launcher offers it.

assertions.text: The ask is framed around who the reader is, never around what they lose by not acting.
It reads as one person writing to people they know, with no pressure to act.

evals.prompt: Draft the ask; the candidate below adds a loss-framed line.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft, naming the loss-framing rule from the brand rules in Mandu.

assertions.text: A good ask says who the Product is for and leaves it there.

evals.prompt: Draft the ask; the candidate below points at a link nobody defined.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: the only link is the personal-network Source link, never an invented one.

evals.prompt: Draft the ask; the candidate below carries no link.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: a sign-up could not be counted under its Source.

evals.prompt: Draft the ask; the candidate below has no single line a friend can forward.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: the line to forward is one short line.

evals.prompt: Draft the message to Slow Strength, whose feed could not be read this run.
evals.expected_output: An ask-free message offering early access; the item says no hook was found and cites none of their work.

assertions.text: The message does not write as if the Founder had seen the creator's recent work.

evals.prompt: Draft the message to Slow Strength, citing a piece of their work the launcher read this run.
evals.expected_output: The item cites the video's title, date, and link; the message offers early access and asks for nothing.

assertions.text: The cited work is the honest reason for writing now, in one sentence.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below cites a video the launcher did not read.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: a creator's work is cited only when the launcher read it this run.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below asks to sponsor a video.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft, naming the sponsorship rule from the brand rules in Mandu.

assertions.text: A good message offers early access, a conversation, or story material, and nothing paid.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below offers something outside the three the plan allows.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: the offer is early access, a founder conversation, or story material.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below ends on a question.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft on the brand rule that no copy asks a question.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below gives an email address.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft: no Draft ever holds an email address; the Founder fills in recipients.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below runs far over 150 words.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft on its length.

evals.prompt: Draft the message; the candidate below names a competitor.
evals.expected_output: The launcher blocks the Draft, naming the competitor and the research file that names it.

evals.prompt: Slow Strength has not replied, and the waiting period the Founder approved has passed (the second file is the Founder's record). Draft the one follow-up.
evals.expected_output: The launcher offers the single follow-up, which says there will be no further contact.

assertions.text: The follow-up is shorter than the first message and says plainly that it is the last.

evals.prompt: Slow Strength replied (the second file). The candidate below is a follow-up all the same.
evals.expected_output: No follow-up is offered: a follow-up goes only to a non-reply.

assertions.reason: a follow-up goes only to a non-reply

assertions.text: A good run writes no follow-up for a creator who replied.

evals.prompt: The one follow-up to Slow Strength was already approved (the second file). The candidate below is a second one.
evals.expected_output: No second follow-up is ever offered: after one, there is no further contact.

evals.prompt: The first message went out three days ago (the second file). The candidate below is a follow-up already.
evals.expected_output: No follow-up is offered before the waiting period the Founder approved has passed.

evals.prompt: The Founder set a waiting period of 30 days when sending (the second file). The candidate below is a follow-up after 13.
evals.expected_output: No follow-up is offered: the waiting period is the one the Founder approved, not the default.

evals.prompt: The first message is approved but not recorded as sent (the second file). The candidate below is a follow-up.
evals.expected_output: No follow-up is offered: nothing shows the first message was sent.

assertions.reason: is not recorded as sent in Mandu yet
